github_top_repos.name: U.S-Rental-Prices-Analysis
github_top_repos.description: Analyzed U.S. state-level rental price trends (2020–2024) to evaluate the impact of household income and housing construction on rent growth using data analytics and visualization techniques.

github_top_repos.name: Sequence-ADT-using-Linked-Lists
github_top_repos.description: A Java project that rebuilds the Sequence data structure using a custom LinkedList and ListNode instead of arrays. The project demonstrates information hiding, modularity, and object-oriented design by separating behavior from implementation. Includes JUnit tests for all core list operations such as insertion, deletion, and traversal.

github_top_repos.name: Text-Indexing-Application-
github_top_repos.description: Java application that reads text, cleans tokens, and generates an alphabetized word index using BST-backed data structures.
